rules.description: Jack reports no device, or the ELD is empty or invalid.

hint.generic: Nothing is connected to this output, or it sent no audio capabilities: check the cable and that the display or receiver is on and set to this input.

rules.description: The sink's identity changed since the previous snapshot (device swapped, receiver powered on or off).

hint.generic: The connected device changed (now {e.sink.key}); capabilities were re-read.

rules.description: The sink advertises E-AC-3 with JOC or TrueHD with Atmos, but passthrough for them is disabled on the server node.

hint.generic: The sink accepts Atmos over {e.sink.atmos_codecs}, but the sound server doesn't pass it through: enable those codecs for this output (pavucontrol "Advanced", or WirePlumber device settings).

rules.description: The device behind the TV advertises more formats over CEC than the TV's own EDID allows.

hint.generic: The device behind the display accepts more ({e.sink.downstream_codecs}) than the display passes on ({e.sink.codecs}). Use eARC (not ARC) on the display, enable passthrough in its audio settings, or connect the PC to the receiver directly.

rules.description: An ARC/eARC setup is likely, but there's no CEC access to confirm the downstream device.

hint.generic: The display seems to pass audio on to a receiver or soundbar (ARC/eARC), but nothing behind it can be identified without CEC. Formats the display lists may not all reach that device.

rules.description: TrueHD or DTS-HD MA advertised on hardware with known HBR failures.

hint.generic: {e.sink.hbr_codecs} need high-bit-rate (HBR) audio, which fails on this hardware in known reports; expect dropouts or silence.

rules.description: The ELD lists compressed formats, but the server node allows PCM only.

hint.generic: The sink accepts {e.sink.compressed}, but the server node allows PCM only: enable passthrough for those codecs (pavucontrol "Advanced", or the WirePlumber iec958Codecs setting).

rules.description: An ELD is present, but the server exposes no detected-codec property.

hint.generic: The server doesn't publish which codecs it detected from the sink (older PipeWire or PulseAudio), so passthrough must be set by hand.
hint.debian: Upgrade PipeWire (1.0 or later detects codecs from the ELD) or set passthrough formats by hand.
hint.fedora: Upgrade PipeWire (1.0 or later detects codecs from the ELD) or set passthrough formats by hand.

rules.description: The hardware allows higher rates, but the server's allowed rates force resampling.

hint.generic: The hardware takes up to {e.hw.max_rate} Hz but PipeWire only runs at {g.clock.allowed_rates}: higher-rate audio is resampled. Add rates to default.clock.allowed-rates in a pipewire.conf.d drop-in.

rules.description: The hardware or sink supports more channels than the active profile carries.

hint.generic: The output takes {e.hw.max_channels} channels but the active profile ({e.server.profile}) carries {e.server.max_channels}: choose a surround profile for this device.

rules.description: Volume, EQ, a filter chain or format conversion alters samples on the path (software volume on a digital output).

hint.generic: Software volume at {e.server.volume_percent}% changes the samples: set it to 100% and use the receiver's volume for bit-perfect playback.

rules.description: Two servers claim one card, or standalone JACK holds a card PipeWire expects.

hint.generic: PipeWire and a native PulseAudio both manage the same sound cards: run one of them (usually PipeWire with pipewire-pulse) and disable the other.
hint.debian: Run PipeWire with pipewire-pulse: install pipewire-pulse and wireplumber, then systemctl --user mask pulseaudio.socket pulseaudio.service.
hint.fedora: Use pipewire-pulseaudio (Fedora's default) and remove the pulseaudio package.
hint.arch: Install pipewire-pulse (it replaces pulseaudio) and remove pulseaudio.

rules.description: The app's client library version differs from the host server's (common in sandboxes).

hint.generic: The app's PipeWire library ({g.client.pipewire_version}) differs from the host's server ({g.pipewire.version}); update the app's runtime.

rules.description: The default device routes through dmix, plug or softvol conversions.

hint.generic: The ALSA default device goes through {g.routing.playback_kinds}: apps using it get converted, mixed or software-volume audio. Open hw:CARD,DEV directly for bit-perfect output.

rules.description: Another process holds the hardware device directly; read-only values are used instead.

hint.generic: Another program holds this device directly, so it can't be opened and its ranges come from /proc; close that program or route it through a sound server.

rules.description: The sink accepts more than the host pin or device can send.

hint.generic: The sink accepts more ({e.sink.max_channels} ch, {e.sink.max_rate} Hz) than this output can send ({e.host.max_channels} ch, {e.host.max_rate} Hz).

rules.description: An HBR format is advertised but the pin or driver can't carry it.

hint.generic: The sink takes {e.sink.hbr_codecs}, which need high-bit-rate audio, but this output's pin can't carry it: those formats can't be passed through.

rules.description: USB class or bus speed caps rate or channels below the device's claims.

hint.generic: The USB device claims {e.usb.claimed_max_rate} Hz but offers {e.host.max_rate} Hz at {e.usb.speed} speed: use a high-speed USB port without a hub.

rules.description: Bit depth drops somewhere on the path.

hint.generic: The device takes {e.hw.max_bits}-bit audio but the server runs it at {e.server.format_bits}-bit.

rules.description: Codec power saving is on (wake-up delay, clicks).

hint.generic: HDA codec power saving is on ({e.driver.power_save} s): expect a short delay or a click when playback starts. Set the snd_hda_intel power_save option to 0 to turn it off.

rules.description: The active video mode leaves too little room for the requested audio.

hint.generic: The current video mode leaves too little room for this audio format: pick a higher-bandwidth mode or a lower audio format.

rules.description: A DP-to-HDMI adapter or dock is detected on an HBR path.

hint.generic: An HDMI sink on a DisplayPort output means an adapter or dock is in the path; many drop high-bit-rate audio ({e.sink.hbr_codecs}).

rules.description: The device advertises LDAC or aptX, but the codec isn't enabled or its plugin isn't installed.

hint.generic: The device supports {e.bt.advertised} but the host offers only {e.bt.available}: install the missing codec plugin for PipeWire.
hint.debian: Install libldac and libfreeaptx0 (PipeWire's spa-0.2-bluetooth then offers LDAC and aptX).
hint.fedora: Install the LDAC and aptX codecs: pipewire-codec-aptx (RPM Fusion) and libldac.

rules.description: The negotiated codec or quality mode is below what both ends support.

hint.generic: {e.bt.negotiated} is in use although both ends support a better codec ({e.bt.available}); pick it in the device's profile settings.

rules.description: The headset profile is active, dropping playback to voice quality.

hint.generic: The headset profile ({e.bt.profile}) is active, so playback is voice quality: switch the device to A2DP (high fidelity playback) when not on a call.

rules.description: No realtime scheduling is available.

hint.generic: No realtime scheduling (rtkit, portal or RLIMIT_RTPRIO): expect dropouts under load.

rules.description: A layer is hidden because a Flatpak permission or Snap plug is missing; names the exact fix.

hint.generic: The sandbox hides parts of the audio system ({g.sandbox.missing}): {g.sandbox.fixes}

rules.description: The app requests less than the path can deliver.

hint.generic: The app plays {app.channels} ch at {app.rate} Hz, but this path delivers up to {e.eff.max_channels} ch at {e.eff.max_rate} Hz.

rules.description: The end-to-end latency estimate misses an app-supplied target.

hint.generic: The estimated end-to-end latency ({e.path.latency_us} µs) misses the app's target ({app.latency_target_us} µs): lower the server quantum or use a direct path.
